feeding_claim.verbatim: Our high-quality beef is 100% natural & grass finished in the pasture.

notes: Family business incorporated in Kansas in 2016, office in the Kansas City area (city Shawnee comes from a third-party business listing, not the farm site, so Verifier should confirm; the pastures are elsewhere). Read the 'pasture to fork' blog post, the FAQ and the 'how we raise our grass-fed beef' post (WebFetch summaries only; homepage and about pages not read, so recheck). Pastures are in the Flint Hills of central Kansas, a small farm about an hour west of Emporia, and southern Colorado. The how-we-raise post says they used to be cow-calf but now buy young calves from neighbors on the same grass-fed program and graze them to harvest; it also says grass-fed producers commonly feed a few pounds of 'cake' as a supplement, so Verifier should check whether any is fed. FAQ: ships within the continental United States (not AK or HI), 3-day ground with faster options; Kansas City metro delivery Monday through Saturday. No halves or quarters mentioned. Owner not clearly named (Chris Kovac authored the post). ordering_url is the packages category inferred from product URLs.
